note: PROTOTYPE — the questions the logging viewer's first version exists to answer (PLAN_LOGGING_VIEWER.md). The web server syncs these into the questions table at boot; the rail shows them on the logging page.

questions.prompt: How long did logging this lesson take, against the lesson's own length? (under 1×, 1–1.5×, 1.5–2×, over 2×)
How often did you fix a brick's edge after marking it? (1 = never, 5 = almost every brick)
Did snapping in and out points to word edges help or get in the way? (helped, neutral, got in the way)
Which keys felt wrong, and what would you press instead?
Did you want to mark retakes as alternatives of one moment? (yes, no, sometimes)
Would you rather say commands than press keys? (1 = keys are fine, 5 = I'd rather speak)
